chunks: As for the unbelievers, they will suffer misfortunes, and their deeds will be rendered ineffective.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the deeds of disbelievers according to Surah Muhammad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the causal link between belief and the validity of deeds, noting that disbelief acts as a nullifier of otherwise good works. It underscores the concept of 'Fata' (woe/misfortune) as both a spiritual loss and a divine decree, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the unity of faith and action for salvation.
